content:
The three root issues (ISS-081/082/087) are answered in docs/snapshot-facts-and-watermarks.md v2. v1 was REJECTED by codex review (session 019fcfc4 — the critical finding: max-instant watermarks attest recency, not completeness, so v1's digest-based "refreshed" could silently publish data loss). v2 adopts all ten findings; §7 dispositions each.

Decisions now binding: (1) sourceVersion keys are SIX ingestion surfaces incl. writer-owned claude-transcript-hours (hourly never came from ccusage) and all-daily (renamed — it carries every agent); fixed key set via an executable registry tied to SCHEMA_VERSION by contract test; retireSources stays deleted. (2) Watermarks = recency only. (3) Coverage attested separately per surface on every publish via stable row identities: additions and in-place updates allowed; disappearance only trailing-edge or age-consistent-empty; anything else is a typed coverage-regression refusal retaining the live generation. Outcomes: published / refreshed / unchanged / refused. Derived-cache purity retained — no history accumulation; blocks stores ccusage's current window exactly as the CLI always showed. (4) Payload = SnapshotPayloadV1: per-surface normalized rows PLUS producer totals (reconciliation needs them), canonical identity-sorted ordering, one branded constructor/validator; codex project attribution resolved at the writer with config identity recorded; size measured against MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES on real data as a T-025 plan gate before anything is built.

T-025's plan phase owns the field-by-field spec, normalizers, identity functions, transition-test matrix, and the size measurement — and MUST resume codex session 019fcfc4 for its plan review so the reviewer keeps context.

Runway when relayed: /story auto T-025 T-011 T-013 T-012 — T-025 re-plans from this doc; T-011/T-013 re-plan from their preserved rev-3 docs plus this doc; ticket-text repairs (ISS-084's four stale-socket sites etc.) are each re-plan's first act.
title: N-009: fact model decided (v2) — surfaces, recency/coverage split, SnapshotPayloadV1 delegated to T-025 plan
